result.title: Locked In: Multi-Objective RL for the AI Data Center Build-Out
result.comment: Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: AI data center build-out is a multi-trillion-dollar, multi-decade infrastructure program. Yet siting, power procurement, and cooling decisions are still made with static, single-point scoring tools. These tools are evaluated once, on day-zero numbers. This is a poor fit. A site's water, power, and carbon profile drifts substantially over the 10 to 20 year asset life. The governing decisions are also irreversible, and they bind capital and physical plant for years. We formalize long-horizon build-out as a tiered multi-objective Markov decision process. Strategic commitments are gated to discrete windows, incur switching costs, and energize only after source-dependent lead times. Operational dispatch is restricted to capacity that physically exists. We solve the problem with a preference-conditioned multi-objective agent that has a semi-Markov manager and worker hierarchy. The agent recovers a family of policies that a planner can steer across cost, carbon, water, and reliability at inference time. We validate long-horizon dynamics with a lightweight counterfactual rollout model. Across three commitment regimes (irreversible, reversible, and commit-once) on real site data, preference conditioning yields a confirmed, steerable trade-off on both objective pairs in every regime. Imposing lock-in produces a more evenly covered frontier and a far more consistent rate of anticipatory retrofit ahead of a binding water-stress constraint than a freely reversible formulation. Finally, a compact counterfactual dynamics model tracks slow-moving state well. It is measurably outperformed by simple persistence on the water-stress axis. We report this limitation rather than obscure it. We release the environment, agents, baselines, and evaluation harness. All of them are grounded in real interconnection-queue, water-stress, and grid-emissions data.

AI.brief_summary: 将 AI 数据中心 10–20 年建设与运行建模为分层多目标马尔可夫决策过程，用偏好条件化的半马尔可夫 manager-worker 智能体在推理时于成本、碳、水、可靠性间调节，并如实报告反事实动力学模型在水应力轴上不及简单持久性基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其在不可逆承诺、切换成本与延迟收益下的序列决策表述，可能为 LVR 的停止/提交决策与计算预算控制提供类比；偏好条件化策略对推理期可控计算分配或可供核查。
